{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders and loyal customers
loyal_completed = real_orders[
    (real_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (real_orders['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of loyal customers with completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
